summary: Frontend-only verification of new Vendor Ledger + Cash Ledger (finledger) screens. All requested flows passed: page render with stat cards/tables/pager, record bill (+₹1500 -> total payable +₹1500), record payment (-₹500 -> total payable -₹500) with paired auto cash-out -₹500 on Cash Ledger, reverse on non-reversal entry appends Reversal row (no Reverse btn on Reversal), Cash Ledger render with cl-summary and per-account cards, cl record movement Receipt +₹2000 and Payment -₹2000 (totals update correctly), cl-reverse appends a Reversal, pagers show 'Showing X–Y of N' and disable Prev on page 1, and role gating works (wh.patna can reach pages but vl-record-bill-btn / vl-record-payment-btn / vl-reverse-* / cl-record-btn / cl-reverse-* are all hidden). Owner sees all buttons. Auto-cash-out from vendor payment confirmed on the Cash Ledger (CASH/3 -₹500 with vendor name).
critical_code_review_comments: VendorLedger.tsx and CashLedger.tsx are reasonable in size (<200 LOC) and use api wrapper + env-based base URL. Good use of data-testid throughout.
Both pages depend on backend role check; UI hiding of finance-only buttons mirrors backend _is_finance gating which is the correct pattern.
Minor: initial Total payable card shows '0.00' for a brief moment until the /balances API resolves; consider a 'Loading…' state or skeleton to avoid the flash of stale zero (not a bug, just polish).
Minor: cl-account-input is a free-text field forced to uppercase; consider a select with the 3 documented accounts (CASH / BANK / UPI) to avoid typos that create orphan account buckets.
PT-driven auto vendor bill was not re-exercised end-to-end through the UI in this run (backend curl-verified by main agent and historical PT-created vendor rows are present in the DB).
seed_data_creation: Created test ledger rows during this run via the UI: VEND/5 bill ₹1500 (TEST-REF-001), VEND/6 payment ₹500 (auto-posted CASH/3 -₹500), VEND/7 reversal of VEND/6, CASH/5 receipt ₹2000, CASH/6 payment ₹2000, CASH/7 reversal of CASH/6. All on vendor 'Aditya Birla Fashion (Madura)' / account CASH. Final state: vendor outstanding ₹31000 (was ₹30000 before), cash total ₹82000 (was ₹80000 before).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vendor + Cash ledger UI is fully working with append-only semantics and finance-role gating. If the next iteration touches PT inward posting, re-exercise the PT Mapper 'Push into system WITH booking' path and verify a new 'Bill / purchase' row appears on /ledgers/vendor (description starts with 'PT inward'), and that ptfile-reverse appends a matching vendor Reversal row.
